title: Cirian Finding the Notary

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Did you dream last night?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you dream last night?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did I what? Dream last night?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did I what? Dream last night?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did I what? Dream last night?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did I what? Dream last night?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Did he now? On your fading code you swear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did he now? On your fading code you swear?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't be here if he didn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't be here if he didn't.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wouldn't be here if he didn't.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wouldn't be here if he didn't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison Mattix, yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison Mattix, yes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison Mattix, yes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison Mattix, yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. I was lying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I was lying.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. I was lying.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. I was lying.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: If I see you around here again, I'll paralyze your augments and push you into the nearest vent. If Edison Mattix is truly your friend, you'd be wise to tell him the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I see you around here again, I'll paralyze your augments and push you into the nearest vent. If Edison Mattix is truly your friend, you'd be wise to tell him the same.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: How do you know his name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you know his name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seriously? You can do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seriously? You can do that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seriously? You can do that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seriously? You can do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I wanted to live like the Notary?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I wanted to live like the Notary?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I wanted to live like the Notary?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I wanted to live like the Notary?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Well now, no one can live like the Notary. But she can build you something more tangible. May I ask how you heard of her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well now, no one can live like the Notary. But she can build you something more tangible. May I ask how you heard of her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We have a mutual friend in common. Edison Mattix.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have a mutual friend in common. Edison Mattix.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We have a mutual friend in common. Edison Mattix.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We have a mutual friend in common. Edison Mattix.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Ah, yes, Edison. How do you know him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, yes, Edison. How do you know him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I help him with a few things here and there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I help him with a few things here and there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I help him with a few things here and there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I help him with a few things here and there.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: As Edison is one to have people do. And, based on the fact that he's got you here seeking out the Notary, he's looking for some ID cards. The other set of debt orphans I assume?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As Edison is one to have people do. And, based on the fact that he's got you here seeking out the Notary, he's looking for some ID cards. The other set of debt orphans I assume?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's what I'm told.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I'm told.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's what I'm told.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's what I'm told.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Yes, well, with the amount of money he owes me I'm not surprised he sent you in his stead. It's like your his automata. I'm curious... How does that fact make you feel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, with the amount of money he owes me I'm not surprised he sent you in his stead. It's like your his automata. I'm curious... How does that fact make you feel?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, do you have the ID cards or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, do you have the ID cards or not?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, do you have the ID cards or not?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, do you have the ID cards or not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just helping him out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just helping him out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm just helping him out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm just helping him out.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I suppose that is why you're here. Well, here they are. Tell Edison, if he wants more, he'll need to pay me what I'm owed. Our business ties are severed until then. Let him try and find his niece without my help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose that is why you're here. Well, here they are. Tell Edison, if he wants more, he'll need to pay me what I'm owed. Our business ties are severed until then. Let him try and find his niece without my help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you mean?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: There's so many things we can do in this world. Let me open the windows so you can have a look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's so many things we can do in this world. Let me open the windows so you can have a look.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will I see the Notary through one of those windows?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will I see the Notary through one of those windows?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Will I see the Notary through one of those windows?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Will I see the Notary through one of those windows?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I haven't dreamt in years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't dreamt in years.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I haven't dreamt in years.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I haven't dreamt in years.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dreaming's the best thing about the day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dreaming's the best thing about the day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Dreaming's the best thing about the day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Dreaming's the best thing about the day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison sent me. Said you ran out on a job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison sent me. Said you ran out on a job.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison sent me. Said you ran out on a job.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison sent me. Said you ran out on a job.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: A welcome reprieve indeed. A glimpse into the kind of life or world the dreamer wants to live in. More and more people are getting smarter to the fact that they can have a sliver of that existence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A welcome reprieve indeed. A glimpse into the kind of life or world the dreamer wants to live in. More and more people are getting smarter to the fact that they can have a sliver of that existence.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time for this. I'm looking for the Notary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for this. I'm looking for the Notary.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time for this. I'm looking for the Notary.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time for this. I'm looking for the Notary.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Then I'd keep looking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I'd keep looking.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I suppose you'd know if you had. Though I'm not sure what's worse: having no dreams at all or having so many you become an addict.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose you'd know if you had. Though I'm not sure what's worse: having no dreams at all or having so many you become an addict.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Let me introduce CameoPOV Media. CPM if you like. You tell me who you admire, whose life you want to live, and I build you an authentic dream-state. One you can rent and live in whenever you close your eyes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me introduce CameoPOV Media. CPM if you like. You tell me who you admire, whose life you want to live, and I build you an authentic dream-state. One you can rent and live in whenever you close your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you saying dreams are bad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you saying dreams are bad?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you saying dreams are bad?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you saying dreams are bad?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dreams are nothing but false promises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dreams are nothing but false promises.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Dreams are nothing but false promises.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Dreams are nothing but false promises.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: What if, rather than false promises, they are glimpses of what you deserve?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if, rather than false promises, they are glimpses of what you deserve?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I would never say such a thing about the greatest gift we've been given. The ability to look into the lives we think we want. The ones we think we deserve. I can show you the existence you dream about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would never say such a thing about the greatest gift we've been given. The ability to look into the lives we think we want. The ones we think we deserve. I can show you the existence you dream about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: An addict?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An addict?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: An addict?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: An addict?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Spreading their dreams from the confines of sleep to their every day lives. Their imaginations giving them complacency. False hopes. Such a shame.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spreading their dreams from the confines of sleep to their every day lives. Their imaginations giving them complacency. False hopes. Such a shame.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much does he owe you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much does he owe you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How much does he owe you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How much does he owe you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll tell him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll tell him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll tell him.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: This is the third class he's taken on a field trip. It's 5,000 Lims per class.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is the third class he's taken on a field trip. It's 5,000 Lims per class.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 15,000 Lims? What if I paid them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 15,000 Lims? What if I paid them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: 15,000 Lims? What if I paid them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: 15,000 Lims? What if I paid them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 15,000 Lims! Shit. I'll tell him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 15,000 Lims! Shit. I'll tell him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: 15,000 Lims! Shit. I'll tell him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: 15,000 Lims! Shit. I'll tell him.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Then, by all accounts, Edison and I would be even and you'd be out 15,000 Lims. Pretty cut and dry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then, by all accounts, Edison and I would be even and you'd be out 15,000 Lims. Pretty cut and dry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll pass.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll pass.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll pass.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Interesting. Now that you know where to find me you should make sure to come back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. Now that you know where to find me you should make sure to come back.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Hmmm. For a second it seemed like the day was about to get interesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. For a second it seemed like the day was about to get interesting.
